tests.provenance: MK9 was recorded owed as VACUOUS: 0 sellers carried a response_rate and marketplace_inquiries was empty, so there was no rendered claim to diff against source truth. That was the right call for a green over an empty denominator - and the wrong place to stop. Checked before assuming: a living producer DOES exist (trg_update_seller_response_stats recomputes both columns from the inquiry history), and the NULLs are the page's honest empty state, not a dead counter. So the probe MANUFACTURES the denominator instead of waiting for one.
tests.note: The recomputation is done independently inside the probe, then pinned to fixed arithmetic (1h+2h+6h)/3 = 3.0 and 3/4 = 0.75 - so a producer that agrees with itself while being wrong still fails. TEETH VERIFIED against the plausible bug this exists to catch: replacing the producer with one that COALESCEs the empty state to 0 made both empty-state assertions report 'NO 0.0' / 'NO 0.00'. A trust signal that lies when a seller is brand new is worse than no signal, and it is the direction a naive COALESCE breaks first.

ufai_earned.F6: a rendered trust figure is diffed against the history that produces it, and the empty state is asserted to stay empty rather than zero

tests.covered_evidence: THREE TIERS, all executed. SEND: notify-push is VAPID-signed and was proven end to end against the real FCM push service. STATIC: 7 invariants on sw.js - a push listener exists, it calls showNotification, that call is INSIDE waitUntil (a bare call works on a warm worker and fails on a cold one), e.data.json() is try/catch-guarded, and notificationclick closes + focuses-or-opens. tests.provenance: FOUND A REAL DEFECT. marketplace.html browsed with .order('created_at',{ascending:false}).limit(PAGE_SIZE); created_at alone is not a TOTAL order because a bulk import inside one transaction shares a fixed now(). Touching an unrelated column on one tied row moved 4 of 12 rows to a different rank with the row set identical, so under LIMIT a listing could be shown twice across a refresh or skipped between pages. Fixed by adding the unique id as a tiebreaker at all six paginated sites in marketplace.html; the experiment then reported rank_changed 4 -> 0. Today's seeded corpus has ZERO ties (21 listings, 21 distinct timestamps), so the probe INDUCES the tie - a naive version of this test would have passed forever while the defect sat there.

_ufai_note: A UFAI class is listed on a cell ONLY where an assertion the cell already makes earns it, with the earning assertion quoted in `ufai_earned`. _ufai_ownership._doc: Which instrument owns each UFAI family, so the bank's ufai % is read correctly. The bank asserts what a RE-RUNNABLE test can hold about transitions, handoffs and truth. It does not re-grade what another gate already walks.

bank_owns.F1 F2 F5 F6: completeness (covered by icon-button-label + aria-label-coverage), correctness, round-trip, degraded states
bank_owns.I1 I2 I3 I4 I5 I6: auth gating, role/permission, tenancy, client validation (covered by input-validation-guard), auditability, safe-by-default

ufai_walk_owns.U1 U2 U5 U6 U7: recognizability, tap targets, a11y, consistency, mobile-field - measured live by tools/validate_service_ufai_deep.py (44px targets, vendored axe, 360-1920 overflow). Duplicating a live browser sweep in a bank cell would duplicate it worse.
ufai_walk_owns.F3 F4: appropriateness and nav-flow - graded 100% on EVERY marketplace page by the UFAI walk with named dims (X1/E4, W1/X3). I first wrote that these had no cell and no evidence; reading the pillar map per PAGE instead of per CLASS showed they were never open.

not_yet_assertable.A1 A2 A6: architecture cells the UFAI walk already grades on these pages.
not_yet_assertable.A3 A4 A5: the only genuinely open cells, and dispositioned with evidence rather than excused: A4 was HUNTED as a concrete stale-hive defect and found absent (a full page load makes the cached value fresh); A3 reduces to the D9 knobs, which have no values yet; A5 is DEMONSTRATED by this arc's denominator growing by itself when a guard changes. Owed, never banked as a weak green.

_ufai_ownership.ceiling: 48% is the bank's honest share: 12 of 25 classes, every one earned by a named cell or a named existing gate. The other 13 are either owned by the live UFAI walk (which grades them at 100%) or are the three A-series cells recorded owed-with-evidence. A higher number here would mean over-claiming, not more coverage.

_retired_axes._why: An axis declared and used on ZERO cells is not a statement of intent, it is coverage that does not exist - and the original plan said so itself: 'a state axis with no induction mechanism is decoration'. Both were verified at 0 of 247 cells before removal (assertion in tools, not assumption). Retiring them names the instrument that ACTUALLY measures each, which is the same disposition already applied to U1/U2/U5/U6/U7: the bank names what another instrument proves rather than re-measuring it worse.

viewport.why_not_here: The deep walk measures 390 and 1280 in a REAL browser with real numbers - 44px tap targets, vendored axe, 360-1920 overflow - and grades worse-per-dimension. A bank cell asserting a viewport could only re-state that from a worse vantage point: the SQL lane has no viewport at all, and the journey lane would be a second, thinner copy of a live sweep that already runs. Precedent: the same call was made for U1/U2/U5/U6/U7.

lang.why_not_here: Language coverage is a static property of the markup and its dictionary - an unresolved `data-i` marker IS the defect, and the i18n gate reads every marker against every dictionary on every page. A per-cell language partition in the bank would multiply cells without adding an assertion that gate does not already make. See feedback_i18n_unresolved_marker_is_broken_translation: count is not correctness.

_covers_tables_doc: Which guard TRANSITIONS this authored probe actually fires. Read by tools/validate_guard_mutation_score.py, which selects cells per guard and would otherwise never show the mutants an authored probe - they carry no `transition` field, so the first score reported guard_service_topup_status at 0% on 1 cell while TB-I2 was asserting exactly the self-deal those mutants create. Under-counting the bank is the same class of error as over-claiming it.

_layer_owners._why: WHAT A THIN LAYER DOES AND DOES NOT MEAN. The layer board counts a layer covered on >=1 BANK cell, so S2-pwa, S7-ai and S9-knowledge each show 1 - and a reader could conclude those layers are barely tested. They are not: the platform carries dedicated gates for each (550 registered in total). The bank's job is the MARKETPLACE's transitions and journeys; a whole-platform concern like offline shell caching or AI cost ceilings is owned by its own instrument, and re-asserting it here would be the second-worse-copy the anti-duplication rule exists to prevent. So the board now names the owners instead of implying absence - the same move already made for the retired viewport/lang axes and for U1/U2/U5/U6/U7. A thin layer is a statement about the BANK's shape, never a claim that nothing tests it.
